faq.question: Is hand sanitizer allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Hand Sanitizer is restricted in carry-on luggage. Standard 3-1-1 liquids rules apply for hand sanitizer in carry-on bags (must be 3.4 ounces or less). Temporary pandemic-related exemptions for larger containers have expired.

faq.question: Can you pack hand sanitizer in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Hand Sanitizer is allowed in checked bags.
